title: Quality Control Inspector (all genders) Job Details | Beyond Gravity
description:
Quality Control Inspector (all genders)

**We are mission critical**

Beyond Gravity, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, is the first startup to combine agility, speed and innovation with decades of experience and proven quality. Around 1600 employees at 12 locations in six countries (Switzerland, Sweden, Austria, Germany, USA and Finland) develop and manufacture products for satellites and launch vehicles with the goal of advancing humankind and enabling the exploration of the world and beyond. Beyond Gravity is the preferred supplier of structures for all types of launch vehicles and a leader in selected satellite products and for constellations in the New Space sector. Beyond Gravity also uses its space knowledge for applications outside of space technology: The high-precision products have already been used in the semiconductor industry for more than 20 years.

**Your responsibilities**

* Execute Quality Control Program in accordance with Project Milestones
* Ensure successful execution of the Customer, Regulatory and Internal Requirements for Operations Execution
* Be active part of the Internal Process for Non-Conformance Management
* Support Process Quality Documentation
* Support Process Qualification
* Contribute as needed to Customer and Internal Audit as Quality Control representative
* Contribute to the Quality Organization Development (Training/Coaching)
* Contribute to the continous improvement of the quality control program

**Your profil**

* Completed vocational training/education (technics, mechanics, mechatronics, electronics)
* Knowledge of standards such as EN9100, ECSS, NASA and MIL
* Ability to quickly understand and analyze technical products/systems and their function
* Excellent written and oral communication skills in German, English is a strong asset
* MS Office experience required
* Experience in the application of Quality preventive methodology (5Why, Ishikawa Fishbone...)

**What we offer**

* Work in an international environment with global mindset and high-tech products that will fly into space
* A highly specialized and motivated team with a lot of know-how in a unique industry
* We live a hands-on mentality and take suggestions for improvement seriously
* Attractive employment conditions (contribution to public transport, trainings and development opportunities, full paid maternity/paternity leave and many more)
* Flexible and mobile working and at least 5 weeks of vacation with possibility to buy additional vacation

**Your contact**

Did we spark your interest in this exciting position? Then we look forward to receiving your online application.

title: Director, Data & AI (m/f/d)
description:
**Job Description** **Title:** Director, Data \& AI (m/f/d)   

**Id:** 21331   

**Type:** FullTime   

**Location:** Luxembourg   

Are you looking to join a world-class manufacturing organization? At Husky TechnologiesTM, we strive to be the best with a strong foundation built on innovation, collaboration and a unique culture with great people. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution -- we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!   

****What We Offer****

* Excellent benefits package and retirement savings plans as well as life insurance program
* Competitive vacation policy promoting work-life balance
* Challenging career opportunities and growth
* Opportunity to work, innovate and collaborate with passionate people who drive change
* Amazing team -- we are the best in the world at what we do!   

**Husky TechnologiesTM Campus**

* Large, beautiful campus with clean, state-of-the-art air-conditioned offices and manufacturing facilities with high air quality, climate control and outstanding safety records
* Onsite fitness and wellness center
* Organized out- and indoor sports activities such as running teams, and bicycle teams
* Access to onsite medical practitioners
* Onsite cafeterias with fresh and healthy meal options
* Free parking   

****Job Description**** Husky is accelerating its use of AI, analytics and data platforms to improve decision speed, operational efficiency, customer experience and cost transparency. We are seeking a Director of Data \& AI who combines hands-on technical depth, product-minded delivery, business partnership and pragmatic governance.   

The role leads the global Data \& AI Office and works in a hub-and-spoke model with business leaders, AI Champions, process owners, architecture, cybersecurity, finance and operations. The Director is accountable for turning data and AI opportunities into measurable business outcomes while ensuring data quality, security, compliance, responsible AI and ITGC-aligned delivery.   

This is not a pure policy or reporting role. The successful candidate must be comfortable operating close to the technology, challenging complexity, enabling rapid pilots, scaling what works and building the standards required to make AI safe, repeatable and enterprise-ready.   

****Responsibilities**** Delivery, Product and Business Value   

* Build and run a portfolio of AI, analytics and data products, prioritizing initiatives with clear business value and measurable outcomes.
* Lead rapid experimentation and scale successful pilots into stable, reusable enterprise capabilities.
* Partner with business leaders and process owners to identify where AI and trusted data can remove friction, improve decisions or redesign work.
* Define value cases, adoption metrics and benefit-realization methods for AI and data initiatives.
* Create reusable delivery patterns for AI agents, analytics products, predictive models, knowledge solutions and automation.   

Hands-On Technical Leadership   

* Remain close to the technical work: review architectures, data models, integration approaches, AI agent designs, prompt/RAG patterns, ML use cases and platform decisions.
* Guide teams on modern cloud data platforms, data warehousing, data products, analytics engineering, Python/SQL practices, MLOps and GenAI solution design.
* Work with architecture, cybersecurity and infrastructure teams to ensure AI/data solutions are secure, scalable and operationally supportable.
* Challenge over-engineering and promote pragmatic designs that can deliver business value quickly without creating long-term technical debt.   

Data Strategy, Governance and Quality   

* Develop and execute the enterprise data strategy aligned with business priorities and AI readiness.
* Establish data ownership, stewardship, quality standards, metadata practices and trusted-data principles across the organization.
* Improve data quality, lineage, accessibility and consistency across core business domains and platforms.
* Ensure compliance with applicable data protection, security, privacy, retention and industry requirements.   

AI Governance and Responsible AI   

* Lead practical AI governance that enables responsible innovation rather than slowing delivery.
* Define standards for AI use-case intake, risk assessment, knowledge-source validation, model/agent review, access control, monitoring and periodic review.
* Ensure AI initiatives meet responsible AI, cybersecurity, privacy, IP protection, auditability and ITGC expectations.
* Partner with Legal, HR, Compliance, Cybersecurity and business leaders on sensitive AI use cases and risk-based controls.   

Operating Model, COE and Adoption   

* Lead the Data \& AI Office as a center of excellence that provides standards, enablement, reusable components and delivery support.
* Operate a hub-and-spoke model with business AI Champions, process owners and functional teams.
* Build data literacy and AI adoption through playbooks, coaching, training and practical examples.
* Recruit, develop and retain a high-performing team across data engineering, analytics, data governance, data science, AI engineering and business analysis.   

Operations, Budget and Performance   

* Manage the Data \& AI budget, vendor relationships, platform consumption and licensing in line with value delivered.
* Implement portfolio reporting on delivery velocity, adoption, value, risks, data quality and operational performance.
* Ensure production AI and data capabilities have clear ownership, lifecycle management, monitoring, support and continuous improvement.   

****Qualifications****

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field.
* 10 years of progressive experience in data, analytics, AI, digital product delivery or related technology leadership roles.
* Proven track record delivering AI, analytics or data products into production, not only strategy or governance frameworks.
* Strong working knowledge of data architecture, cloud data platforms, data warehousing, analytics engineering, data governance and information security.
* Practical understanding of GenAI, LLMs, AI agents, RAG patterns, ML lifecycle, model governance and responsible AI concepts.
* Ability to lead mixed teams of data engineers, BI/analytics developers, data scientists, AI engineers, business analysts and governance specialists.
* Excellent executive communication skills, including the ability to translate technical topics into business value, risk and investment decisions.
* Hands-on technologist with builder mentality
* Business translator with change management attitude
* Governance-minded enabler
* Fluent in English
* Additional language skills considered an asset  

****Strongly Preferred****

* Experience with Microsoft ecosystem including Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Power Platform, Copilot Studio and M365 Copilot.
* Experience in industrial, manufacturing, engineering, aftermarket, supply chain or complex B2B environments.
* Experience building or operating an AI Center of Excellence, data office, analytics CoE or hub-and-spoke delivery model.
* Good understanding of ITGC, SOX-style controls, cybersecurity, privacy and compliance expectations in enterprise environments.
* Experience with Python, SQL, APIs, data pipelines, MLOps, automation and modern software delivery practices.   

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

title: Senior Vice-President Project Finance Advisory (Climate Mitigation)
description:
Position: SVP Project Finance Advisory

Location: Remote, with periodic travel to our Luxembourg headquarters and to deal jurisdictions

Experience: 10+ years in climate mitigation project finance, including a mandatory minimum of 7 years' experience as a Project Finance Advisor and proven experience leading deal teams (international experience required)

Type: Full-time

Reports to: Head of Business Development and Investor Relations

Company Description

SPONSOR is committed to scaling climate finance by addressing barriers that prevent clean energy projects from reaching financial close. Each year, thousands of viable projects face challenges due to a lack of bankability and risk visibility. Combining decades of project finance expertise with innovative technology, SPONSOR makes clean energy projects investment ready. We are driving the growth of the USD 1.8 trillion Climate Mitigation Project Finance industry.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly experienced SVP Project Finance Advisory to take senior ownership of our largest and most complex climate mitigation project finance deals, from origination through financial close. Beyond leading deals personally, this individual will continue to build and develop the Project Finance team, set the standards by which every project is structured and reviewed, and act as a senior representative of the organization with our most important clients and partners.

The ideal candidate combines deep, hands-on expertise in international climate mitigation project finance with a track record of building and leading high-performing teams. A minimum of 7 years' experience as a project finance advisor and demonstrated experience leading deal teams are both required for this role. A genuine commitment to advancing global decarbonization is essential. Our company is focused on making it easier for the industry to originate, structure, and finance climate mitigation projects.

Key Responsibilities

• Own and lead the organization's largest, most complex climate mitigation project finance deals, from origination to financial close, ensuring alignment with investment and risk management strategy.

• Structure and negotiate debt and equity financing arrangements, including the most structurally challenging transactions in the pipeline.

• Build, manage and mentor a team of VP and associate deal leads, providing coaching, quality and escalation support across the deal pipeline.

• Serve as a senior point of contact for key lenders, investors, development finance institutions, and strategic partners, deepening long-term relationships at the most senior level.

• Set and continuously refine the deal execution playbook, due-diligence standards, and risk frameworks used across the team.

• Partner with senior leadership on capital-raising strategy, platform growth, and the identification of new geographies, sectors or financing structures.

• Conduct or oversee due diligence on financial, regulatory, and technical aspects of deals, and review the financial models and risk assessments prepared by the team.

• Collaborate with internal legal, engineering, and business development leadership to ensure seamless execution across the full transaction lifecycle.

• Stay ahead of industry trends, regulatory change, and market dynamics affecting climate mitigation project finance, and translate them into actionable input for strategy.

Qualifications

Minimum Requirements (Mandatory)

• Minimum of 7 years' experience as a Project Finance Advisor.

• Proven, hands-on experience leading deal teams, not solely individual deal execution.

Finance \& Deal-Making Expertise

• 10+ years of experience in climate mitigation project finance, with substantial international experience.

• Demonstrated track record leading and closing large, structurally complex transactions, including debt, equity, and blended finance.

• Deep expertise in financial modeling, credit analysis, and risk assessment, at a level sufficient to review and quality-control the work of others.

• Extensive experience negotiating and closing project finance agreements, including term sheets, loan agreements, and power purchase agreements (PPAs), typically as the senior-most deal negotiator.

Leadership \& People Management

• Proven experience building, mentoring, developing and leading a high-performing deal team, not only executing deals individually.

• Comfortable setting team-wide standards, workflows, quality benchmarks, and holding others to them.

• Experience managing accountability for a multi-deal pipeline delivered by others, not just one's own transactions.

Strategic \& Organizational Impact

• Ability to translate market trends, regulatory shifts, and portfolio performance into actionable input for firm strategy.

• Experience engaging directly with a Board, Investment Committee, or equivalent senior governance body.

• Strong track record representing an organization externally with lenders, investors, development finance institutions, and industry bodies.

• Genuine commitment to sustainability and global decarbonization, with the credibility to represent that mission publicly.

Why Join Us?

• Lead the highest-impact climate mitigation financings in our portfolio, with true ownership over deal strategy and outcomes.

• Build and shape a growing deal execution team from a senior leadership seat.

• Join a mission-driven, cooperative organization structured around shared ownership rather than a traditional corporate hierarchy.

• Participate in a co-op structure with shared upside and a collaborative culture.

• 100% remote-first culture, with the flexibility that comes with it and periodic travel as noted above.

• Be part of closing the climate finance gap at a pivotal moment for the sector.

How to Apply Please submit your CV and a brief cover note to info@sponsorgo.com, referencing "SVP Project Finance Advisory."

How to Apply Please submit your CV and a brief cover note to yoshi@sponsorgo.com, referencing "SVP Project Finance Advisory."

title: Product Owner Digital
description:
About Proximus Luxembourg

Proximus Luxembourg is a leading historical player in the ICT \& Telecoms markets. Proximus Luxembourg addresses both residential and business markets through its commercial brands Tango, Proximus NXT and more recently Codit.

With PSF support status, the company has almost 800 employees. All these experts share a passion for digital technology, a spirit of openness and innovation, and a desire to simplify, connect and make their customers' personal and professional activities ever more secure.

Proximus Luxembourg is actively contributing to the acceleration of Luxembourg's digitalisation and its economic influence through the development of connectivity, resilient infrastructures and 5G, as well as innovative technologies such as Blockchain, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and IoT.

Proximus Luxembourg is a subsidiary of the Proximus group (Euronext Brussels: PROX), provider of digital services and communication solutions operating in the Belgian and international markets.

Your mission:

As a Digital Product Owner, you will contribute to the evolution of our digital products and customer journeys, helping to deliver seamless and valuable experiences for our customers across digital channels.

Working closely with business stakeholders, UX/UI designers, developers and product teams, you will gather requirements, prioritize initiatives and translate business needs into digital solutions. You will play a key role in the continuous improvement of our websites, mobile applications and customer self-service tools.

**Your responsibilities**

**Product Development \& Delivery**

* Contribute to the definition and evolution of digital products and services.

* Translate business and customer needs into clear product requirements.

* Manage and prioritize the product backlog in alignment with business objectives.

* Write User Stories, acceptance criteria and functional specifications.

* Support Agile delivery by participating in backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives.

* Coordinate the implementation of digital solutions with internal and external stakeholders.

* Ensure features are delivered according to agreed priorities, quality standards and timelines.  

**Customer Journey \& Digital Experience**

* Contribute to the design and optimization of customer journeys across digital channels.

* Work closely with Telecom \& TV Product Managers to improve digital onboarding and lifecycle management experiences.

* Identify opportunities to enhance self-service capabilities and customer satisfaction.

* Support UX/UI improvements across digital platforms and tools.

* Help ensure a consistent customer experience across websites, mobile applications and other digital touchpoints.  

**Business Analysis \& Continuous Improvement**

* Gather, analyse and formalise business requirements.

* Facilitate workshops to understand user needs and identify improvement opportunities.

* Model business processes and customer journeys.

* Monitor digital performance indicators and contribute to product improvement initiatives.

* Analyse customer feedback, usage data and business needs to identify areas for enhancement.  

**Support \& Documentation**

* Maintain product documentation and functional specifications.

* Create clear user guides, FAQs and support materials.

* Provide Level 2 functional support and coordinate issue resolution with technical teams.  

Your profile:

**Experience**

* Minimum 3 years of experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst or in a similar digital role.

* Experience working on customer-facing digital products and services.

* Experience in a B2C environment such as telecommunications, e-commerce, banking, insurance or digital services is considered an asset.  

**Skills \& Knowledge**

* Solid experience with Agile methods (Scrum, Kanban) and collaborative approaches (Design Thinking, Story Mapping)

* Experience in requirements gathering and backlog management.

* Proficiency with digital concepts and tools (websites, mobile apps, CRM, electronic signatures, APIs, etc.) and an interest in new technologies (AI, automation, etc.)

* UX/UI expertise and the ability to challenge user flows

* Ability to write clear User Stories and functional specifications.

* Knowledge of business process modelling and customer journey mapping.

* Understanding of digital customer journeys, websites, mobile applications and self-service platforms.

* Familiarity with digital KPIs, analytics and data-driven decision making.

* Understanding of APIs and digital system integrations.

* Awareness of GDPR, accessibility and data security principles.  

**Technical Skills \& Tools**

* Jira or equivalent Agile backlog management tool.

* Confluence, SharePoint or equivalent collaboration tools.

* Data oriented: comfortable analyzing usage data (e.g., Google Analytics or similar is a plus)

* Knowledge of process modeling tools (Visio, Lucid, etc.) and prototyping/mockup tools (Figma)

* Ability to collaborate with technical teams to validate the feasibility of solutions and balance functional versus technical considerations  

**Soft Skills**

* Customer-oriented mindset.

* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

* Ability to prioritise and make informed decisions.

* Analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.

* Autonomy and adaptability.

* Team spirit and cross-functional collaboration.

* Structured and detail-oriented approach.  

**Nice to Have**

* PSPO or CSPO certification.

* SAFe knowledge or certification.

* Experience in the telecommunications industry or another regulated sector.  

**Languages**

* Fluent French is mandatory.

* English is considered an asset.  

Our offer:

* **A professional, stimulating and innovative working environment:**

Joining Proximus Luxembourg means becoming part of a human-sized company while benefiting from the strength, expertise and opportunities offered by the Proximus Group. You will work within dynamic, supportive and collaborative teams, where team spirit, knowledge sharing and innovation play a central role.
* **Genuine career opportunities within the Proximus Group:**

You will have the opportunity to develop your career within Proximus Luxembourg and the Proximus Group, both nationally and internationally. Thanks to the diversity of our activities, internal mobility opportunities and an environment that encourages continuous learning, you will be able to strengthen your skills and grow your expertise in innovative fields such as cloud, data, artificial intelligence, telecommunications and emerging technologies. You will benefit from personalized support and tailored training programs to support your professional development.
* **An attractive remuneration package and benefits that support your work-life balance:**

Your salary is defined according to a clear salary framework, taking into account your professional experience, skills and seniority. The recruiter will share the applicable salary range with you before the first interview. You will also benefit from flexible working hours with the possibility of teleworking, as well as numerous benefits: meal vouchers, the possibility of a company car, "quality time" dedicated to supporting your work-life balance (4 hours per month), additional days of leave linked to our collective agreement, sports and well-being activities, and much more.
* **A company committed to diversity and inclusion:**

Proximus Luxembourg promotes equal opportunities and provides an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and develop their full potential. Our multicultural teams, representing 34 nationalities, reflect the richness of our company culture.

As part of the recruitment process, a criminal record extract may be requested. Your personal data is processed in accordance with applicable data protection regulations.

title: Senior Infrastructure & Security Engineer
description:
Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités technologiques dans le secteur financier, nous recherchons un(e) **Senior Infrastructure \& Security Engineer** capable de concevoir de zero, sécuriser et faire évoluer des plateformes cloud à haute criticité.

Vous interviendrez sur des environnements **Microsoft Azure et Azure Databricks**, utilisés pour héberger des applications, des plateformes data et des services d'intelligence artificielle soumis à de fortes exigences de sécurité, de résilience et de conformité.

Ce poste combine expertise technique, architecture cloud, cybersécurité opérationnelle et gouvernance. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Infrastructure, Data, AI, Software Engineering, Risk et Compliance.

**Vos responsabilités**

**Architecture Azure**

* Concevoir et faire évoluer des architectures Azure sécurisées, résilientes et industrialisées.

* Déployer des architectures réseau de type **hub-and-spoke** avec Azure Virtual Network, Private Link, Private Endpoints, Azure Firewall, Network Security Groups et contrôle centralisé des flux.

* Mettre en œuvre une stratégie **Zero Trust**, sans exposition publique directe des workloads critiques.

* Sécuriser les connexions hybrides via VPN, ExpressRoute et services d'interconnexion privés.

* Concevoir des dispositifs de haute disponibilité, de sauvegarde, de reprise d'activité et de continuité opérationnelle.

* Piloter la standardisation des infrastructures à travers l'Infrastructure as Code, notamment avec Terraform, Bicep ou Azure DevOps.  

**Sécurité cloud et identité**

* Définir et maintenir les standards de sécurité Azure et Microsoft Entra ID.

* Mettre en œuvre des modèles IAM robustes basés sur le RBAC, le principe du moindre privilège, les Managed Identities, Privileged Identity Management et les accès Just-in-Time.

* Administrer les politiques Conditional Access, MFA, Identity Protection et les mécanismes de gouvernance des identités.

* Sécuriser les secrets, certificats et clés cryptographiques via Azure Key Vault et, lorsque nécessaire, des mécanismes de clés gérées par le client.

* Déployer et optimiser les solutions Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR et les mécanismes de détection et de réponse aux incidents.

* Participer aux analyses de vulnérabilité, tests de sécurité, investigations et plans de remédiation.  

**Azure Databricks et sécurité de la donnée**

* Concevoir et sécuriser les environnements **Azure Databricks** utilisés pour les plateformes Data et AI.

* Mettre en place des workspaces privés, sans accès Internet public, intégrés aux réseaux Azure.

* Sécuriser les clusters, les communications réseau, les accès aux données et les processus CI/CD.

* Implémenter une gouvernance centralisée avec **Unity Catalog**, Microsoft Purview et des politiques d'accès granulaires.

* Assurer la séparation des environnements Development, Test, Acceptance et Production.

* Mettre en œuvre le chiffrement des données au repos et en transit, la gestion des secrets, la traçabilité des accès et l'audit des opérations.

* Collaborer avec les Data Engineers et AI Engineers afin d'intégrer la sécurité dès la conception des pipelines, modèles et produits analytiques.  

**Conformité et gouvernance**

* Contribuer au développement et au maintien du système de management de la sécurité de l'information selon **ISO/IEC 27001**.

* Participer à la gouvernance des systèmes d'intelligence artificielle selon **ISO/IEC 42001**.

* Traduire les exigences réglementaires et normatives en contrôles techniques mesurables et auditables.

* Participer aux démarches de conformité liées à **DORA**, au RGPD, à NIS2 et aux exigences applicables aux prestataires technologiques du secteur financier.

* Produire et maintenir les politiques, standards, procédures, matrices de contrôle et éléments de preuve nécessaires aux audits.

* Participer aux analyses de risques, Business Impact Assessments, exercices de continuité et évaluations des fournisseurs.

* Accompagner les audits internes, externes et clients.  

**Sécurité opérationnelle**

* Définir les standards de logging, monitoring, alerting et gestion des incidents.

* Améliorer les capacités de détection à travers des règles SIEM, des playbooks SOAR et des scénarios de réponse automatisés.

* Piloter les processus de patch management, vulnerability management et configuration management.

* Participer à la gestion des incidents de sécurité et aux analyses post-incident.

* Mettre en place des indicateurs permettant de mesurer la posture de sécurité, la résilience et l'efficacité des contrôles.

* Assurer une veille continue sur les menaces, vulnérabilités et évolutions technologiques.  

**Votre profil**

* Minimum 5 à 8 années d'expérience en infrastructure, cloud engineering, architecture ou cybersécurité.

* Expertise confirmée sur Microsoft Azure et Microsoft Entra ID.

* Expérience dans des environnements critiques, réglementés ou liés au secteur financier.

* Bonne maîtrise des architectures réseau Azure, de la sécurité cloud et des modèles Zero Trust.

* Expérience pratique avec Azure Databricks ou des plateformes Data comparables.

* Maîtrise de l'Infrastructure as Code, des pipelines CI/CD et des pratiques DevSecOps.

* Connaissance approfondie des mécanismes IAM, du chiffrement, de la gestion des secrets et de la sécurité réseau.

* Expérience avec Microsoft Sentinel, Defender for Cloud ou des solutions SIEM/SOAR similaires.

* Bonne compréhension d'ISO/IEC 27001, des analyses de risques et des mécanismes de contrôle interne.

* Une connaissance d'ISO/IEC 42001, de DORA, du RGPD, de NIS2 ou des exigences CSSF constitue un avantage important.

* Capacité à documenter des architectures complexes et à communiquer avec des interlocuteurs techniques, métiers, Risk, Compliance et Direction.

* Français et anglais professionnels requis. L'allemand, le néerlandais ou le luxembourgeois constituent un atout.  

**Certifications appréciées**

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert

* Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate

* Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate

* Databricks Certified Data Engineer ou Databricks Certified Security Specialist

* ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer ou Lead Auditor

* CISSP, CCSP, CISM ou équivalent

* Certifications Terraform, Kubernetes ou DevSecOps

title: Depositary Officer
description:
**About Us** As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning "The Other House" in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.   

With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different - in what we do, in how we work and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.   

Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com   

**Your Future Responsibilities**

* Actively participating in the day to day operational depositary work, ensuring compliance of Alternative Investment Funds with regulations, with a focus on the following depositary duties:

* 

* Cash monitoring

* 

* Oversight   

* 

* Safekeeping

* Performing analysis and controls in order to mitigate the risk linked to depositary services.

* Assisting in drafting answers to clients' requests for proposals and their related fee proposals.

* Participating in performing due diligence on our third parties.

* Being the clients' contact point for both operational topics and the management of internal and external parties' relationships such as Asset Managers, Administrators, Auditors, etc.   

**Your Profile**

* You hold a bachelor degree preferably in Accounting \& Finance or Economics.

* You show interest in the Financial Sector and specifically in the Private Equity and Real Estate Industry.

* You have between 0 and 2 years of relevant experience.

* You are fluent in English (Knowledge of French and/or German will be considered as an asset).

* You have very good knowledge of MS Office.

* You are organised, flexible and able to manage several tasks.

* You are keen to work in a small structure and you combine a large autonomy with the necessary attention to details.

* You are dynamic and have excellent communication skills.

* You possess team spirit, the capacity to build strong client relationships and take initiative to act without waiting for direction when appropriate.   

**What We Offer** We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.   

Our industry-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.   

**Our Global Benefits Also Include**

* Support for professional accreditations such as ACCA and study leave

* Flexible arrangements, generous holidays, plus an additional day off for your birthday!

* Continuous mentoring along your career progression

* Active sports, events and social committees across our offices

* 24/7 support available from our Employee Assistance Program

* The opportunity to invest in our growth and success through our Employee Share Plan

* Plus additional local benefits depending on your location   

Alter Domus is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Equity Statement   

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.   

(Alter Domus Privacy notice can be reviewed via Alter Domus webpage: https://alterdomus.com/privacy-notice/)

title: Conducteur de ligne automatisée en fromagerie (H/F/D)
description:
**Qui sommes-nous ?**

**LUXLAIT Association Agricole** , la laiterie luxembourgeoise emblématique, connue pour ses produits de qualité et son engagement envers les producteurs.  
Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous recherchons pour rejoindre notre équipe :  

**1 Conducteur de ligne automatisée en fromagerie (H/F/D)**

**++Pour entrée dès que possible en CDI - 40h/semaine++**

**🎯 Votre mission**

En tant que **Conducteur de ligne automatisée en fromagerie**, vous serez chargé(e) de superviser et contrôler le fonctionnement des machines et équipements automatisés de production de fromage, assurant leur bon déroulement et la qualité du produit.

En tant que \<\< Conducteur de ligne automatisée \>\>, et en collaboration avec le responsable d'atelier, vous devrez :

* Assurer la transformation du lait en fromage sur une ligne automatisée,

* Surveiller les différentes étapes de production des fromages type PPNC et PPC,

* Intervenir sur tout ou partie des activités liées à la production de fromage,

* Gérer et assurer une amélioration continue des produits et, le cas échéant, des processus de fabrication,

* Veiller au respect des règles de qualité (Normes IFS et ISO 22000)  

**👤 Profil recherché :**

* Expérience en industrie sur ligne automatisée

* Une 1ère expérience en laiterie, ou autre secteur agroalimentaire, est considérée comme un atout

* Caractère rigoureux, créatif, avoir de bonnes qualités sensitives, savoir travailler en équipe.

* Autonome et organisé, faisant preuve de réelles qualités professionnelles.

* Vous savez proposer des solutions alternatives réalistes aux problématiques que vous rencontrez.

* Une parfaite maîtrise du Français est requise ; toute autre langue est un atout.

* Tavail en poste (3 X 8), y compris les Week-ends.  

**💡Pourquoi rejoindre Luxlait ?**

* Avant tout pour partager la passion de la qualité de nos produits afin de valoriser la production de nos producteurs agriculteurs

* Contribuer activement à la coopération au sein de l'équipe avec confiance, solidarité et respect

* Un cadre de travail moderne, spacieux au sein d'un environnement verdoyant

* Une salle de sport à votre disposition

* Un restaurant d'entreprise avec tarif salarié préférentiel

* Et bien d'autres avantages....  

Nous avons hâte de faire votre connaissance et d'échanger sur les opportunités qui s'offrent à vous au sein de notre équipe. C'est avec impatience que nous découvrirons votre talent et vous accueillerons parmi nous !
